body:
With NX8's 8-bit static formats, the tensor that loses most even in its best format is layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256: 32.1 dB SQNR (signal-to-quantization-noise ratio; higher is better) in fp8_e2m5, measured on that tensor alone by the format search. Measured on 6 models with a format search (of 297 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 25.8 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 12.7 dB (stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae). 4 of 6 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: openai-community/gpt2 (perplexity 47 → 81.5, higher is worse), facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (token agreement 100% → 64%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's) and stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (token agreement 100% → 68%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's).

The tensors that lose most in their best format (their own error): layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 32.1 dB), add output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.0 dB), mul output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.5 dB), linear bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e2m5, 34.7 dB), linear output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 35.5 dB), linear output in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e3m4, 35.8 dB), groupnorm bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e2m5, 35.8 dB), add output in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e3m4, 36.2 dB), conv2d bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e3m4, 36.6 dB) and div output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 36.9 dB).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): mul outputs end furthest from full precision, facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 keeping only -0.8 dB there. The outputs furthest from full precision in each model's best format set: mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, -0.8 dB), linear in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 7.6 dB), linear in google/vit-base-patch16-224 (fp8_e3m4, 9.0 dB), attention in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 9.2 dB), linear in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 9.2 dB), softmax in google/vit-base-patch16-224 (fp8_e3m4, 9.7 dB), add in google/vit-base-patch16-224 (fp8_e3m4, 10.0 dB), gelu in google/vit-base-patch16-224 (fp8_e3m4, 10.2 dB), silu in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 10.5 dB) and attention in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 11.1 dB).

Formats chosen (E = exponent bits, M = mantissa bits, u = unsigned): fp8_e2m5 2737 (59%), fp8_e3m4 1097 (24%), fp8_e1m6 771 (17%); 0% of tensors use an unsigned format.

A wider format or a per-row choice would recover most where a tensor's own error in its format, times its data, is largest: silu output in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 42.4 dB), conv2d weight in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 42.7 dB) and conv2d bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 43.2 dB).

1 missing capability keep 29 operations in 1 model (of 4 planned) off the chip's direct path; the most widespread is run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip) (29 operations in 1 model). In two sections, each ranked by the MACs its gaps hold:

### Substitute proposed or evaluated (0 gaps)

None.

### Found by the plan, not yet tried (1 gap)

**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip).** The chip cannot read memory at an address computed at run time, so every lookup or choice by a run-time value (embedding) needs a workaround. It affects 29 operations in 1 model: 29 calls (1.32% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: embedding in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256. Cost today: 0 of 29 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 29 wait for one; 0 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, none evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

title: Missing instructions: 29 operations in 1 model need workarounds

body:
A kernel reads a tensor in the arrangement its writer stored it in; when the reader needs another arrangement, the reading kernel has to rearrange the data itself. This happens to 365 of 533 tensors passed between kernels (68%) in 4 models: 207 for attention heads split or merged, 139 for other reshapes, 16 for pixels reordered and 3 for image patches.

The reading operations are 227 operations (227 calls, 10% of all calls; 80.3 G MACs, 3.43% of all MACs). The most common causes (writer → reader): linear → attention (attention heads split or merged) 207, linear → add (other reshapes) 58 and linear → mul (other reshapes) 56; most in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (196), stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (128) and mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (33).

Cost today: extra cycles not measured yet (no reading kernel has run); 0 links fail.
title: Layout conversions: 365 of 533 tensors between kernels are rearranged

body:
Activations such as exp, GELU and reciprocal go through a 256-entry lookup table (LUT), which limits their precision: 656 operations in 4 models (656 calls, 30% of all calls), most often silu (210), layernorm (126) and groupnorm (113). Their quantized accuracy: worst 9.2 dB SQNR over 656 measured operations.

Kernels per forward pass (host launches, one per planned kernel call): median 31, most 58 (facebook/DiT-XL-2-256, 58 planned groups), over 4 models.

FP32 headroom (how far the largest value is from FP32 overflow, in powers of ten) is least at 34.4 powers of ten for mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (largest value 1.48e+04).

Instruction memory (IMEM, 1,024 words per bank) use: not measured yet (no kernel built).
title: Resource limits: 656 operations limited by the LUT and up to 58 kernel launches per pass

body: The heaviest cost is layout conversion: 357 of 517 tensors passed between kernels (69%) must be rearranged by the reading kernel, affecting 219 operations (11% of calls, 14% of MACs), mostly for attention-head splits in DiT-XL-2-256. Next, 550 operations (28% of calls) are limited by a 256-entry LUT for activations like silu, layernorm and attention, with worst 9.2 dB SQNR, and passes need a median 49 kernel launches (up to 58). NX8 8-bit formats cost accuracy: model outputs keep a median 26.9 dB SQNR (worst 12.7 dB), 4 of 5 models lose prediction quality (gpt2 perplexity 47→81.5, DiT agreement 100%→64%), and mul outputs accumulate the most path error (-0.8 dB); 65% of tensors use fp8_e2m5. Run-time addressing is missing, keeping 29 embedding calls (1.48% of calls, no MACs) off-chip with no workaround yet tried and no accuracy or cycle cost measured. Compute efficiency (MAC utilisation) and IMEM usage are not yet measured, and no workarounds or extra kernels have been built for any gap.
